## 06 Check mail
Started by the scheduler (workflow 00), by default every 30 minutes, **only while the optional Gmail part is switched on and a Google login is in `.env`**. It makes one call to the service (`POST /mail/run`).

That call checks the login, searches your mailbox for replies to your applications (read-only, at most the schedule's batch of emails per run), asks Claude about the few replies the rules could not decide (under the spending caps, at most 10 a run and 40 a day), and writes status *suggestions*. **Nothing changes until you accept one in the dashboard.** The answer holds counts only, never an email's text.

**Settings live in the database, not here:** `scripts/jobsearch gmail` (state, how far back the first search looks) and `scripts/jobsearch schedule` (how often, and how many emails a run opens). Switch the part on with `scripts/jobsearch features set --gmail on`. It does nothing while it is off or not configured.

**Credentials needed:** none here (the service holds the Google login in `.env`).
